scope: Numerical field implementation and conditional source refinement only. No kinematic response scoring or source posterior admission.
source_reason: Mass/depth/source-covariance and exterior-field constraints remain incomplete; this implementation cannot admit new motion comparisons.
equations: The same anisotropic seven-point Poisson stencil and face-centered QUMOND flux as mond_atlas_rectangular_fields.py; only storage and transform chunking change.
transform: DST-I is separable. Apply full-length one-dimensional transforms to bounded groups of independent pencils; divide the complete spectral eigenvalue sum in blocks.
qumond: Compute the existing face-flux stencil on overlapping physical-space slabs; discard halo outputs and keep each global interior cell exactly once.
storage: NumPy .npy memory maps for Newtonian potential, QUMOND source, MOND potential and reusable spectral work. OS page caching is not a strict resident-memory guarantee.
nonclaims: No AQUAL implementation in this package
